Ecomoda is a television series sequel to Ugly Betty in 2001 on RCN. It recounts what has happened during Armando and Betty's married life, as well as new little stories with their parents and new characters. This continuation does not revolve around the love story between Betty and Armando, although of course they will receive the most attention, it is just that in this installment all the characters will have a greater appreciation of what happens to them in their lives and what they are going to face, so most of the episodes are easily not connected to each other, being like small stories but of course without losing the main plot: the future relationship between Ecomoda and Fashion Group.
